responseText: That happens. Here are a few more ways to try.

followUps.title: Look for a pattern
followUps.text: Does it happen at a certain time of day, when Mom is tired, hungry or has nothing to do? Answering that need can help more than any words.

followUps.title: Shorter, and written down
followUps.text: Use fewer words, the same each time, and point to the note: "It's on the board. I'll tell you when."

followUps.title: Give her something to do
followUps.text: Folding towels, sorting photos, helping with dinner. Busy hands quiet a worried loop.

plan.cue: If Mom asks the same question again,
plan.response: I say: you're safe, I'm here.
plan.reset: One slow breath before I answer
